In the team's search for Hamm, they stumble upon a possessed doll. Battle begins when examining the doll house on display in the shop window. 

Amber will rag doll-float throughout the shop. Almost all her attacks are area-of-effect, except for when she torpedoes toward you. So, whenever the giant doll stops abruptly, shoots straight up, or does any other sudden movement—dodge roll away to get out of range.
